text_block_list.text:
I run into Мэйсё Дото in the hallway as
she's
letting out a long and deep sigh.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Why am I such a mess?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh, T-Trainer... It's nothing serious, only
that my
skin has started feeling a little
patchy...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
It must be because yesterday I mistook
the
sesame oil for soy sauce... and put it
on my side
dish.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
But then my hand slipped... turning my
vegetables
into sesame oil soup.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I suppose she was against throwing the
dish away.
Her skin trouble and latest
blunder leave Meisho
Doto in a slump.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
